tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across guides, FAQs, legal updates, Malta hub pages, localities, directory, beaches, heritage, statistics, documents and property listings. Returns ids for `fetch`.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Returns one document as Markdown with its provenance (author, reviewer, last-verified date, official sources). Accepts a search result id, a maltamprp.com URL, or `programme/<section>`.

tools.name: get_mprp_programme
tools.description: The verified programme data: property thresholds, fees and contributions with effective dates and legal references, requirements, application steps, required documents and dependant rules.

tools.name: calculate_mprp_cost
tools.description: Itemised estimate of government fees, contributions and property minimums for a given family composition and property route (purchase or rent).

tools.name: list_content
tools.description: Enumerates guides, FAQs, updates, pages, localities, beaches, heritage sites, directory entries, videos, sources, events, history, Maltese phrases or requirements.

tools.name: malta_statistics
tools.description: Verified statistics (population, economy, prices, housing, climate, …) with value, period, methodology and the official source.

tools.name: cost_of_living
tools.description: Typical monthly costs in Malta and Gozo (housing, utilities, food, transport, healthcare, education, leisure) with ranges, dates and sources.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Current property listings from the RE/MAX Lux feed, filterable by sale/rent, locality, price, bedrooms and MPRP threshold eligibility.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Full details of one listing by reference (e.g. P-1206) or slug, including the MPRP threshold check and how to enquire.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Sends a consultation or property enquiry to the platform's consultants on behalf of a user who has given explicit consent. Returns a reference only.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: fetch, search_properties · Private data: search, fetch, get_mprp_programme · Public sink: submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: fetch, search_properties · Private data: search, fetch, get_mprp_programme · Public sink: submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
